subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Discutir a importância da preservação e conservação da biodiversidade, considerando parâmetros qualitativos e quantitativos, e avaliar os efeitos da ação humana e das políticas ambientais para a garantia da sustentabilidade do planeta.

components.description_pt: Explicar a importância da preservação da biodiversidade usando parâmetros qualitativos
components.description_en: Explain the importance of biodiversity preservation using qualitative parameters
components.cc_component_description: Explain why biodiversity is essential to the sustainability of human societies

components.description_pt: Avaliar efeitos da atividade humana na biodiversidade usando parâmetros quantitativos
components.description_en: Evaluate the effects of human activity on biodiversity using quantitative parameters
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate both negative and positive consequences of human-driven environmental changes on biodiversity and ecosystems

components.description_pt: Avaliar a efetividade de políticas ambientais em assegurar a sustentabilidade planetária
components.description_en: Evaluate the effectiveness of environmental policies in ensuring planetary sustainability
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate human resource management practices based on their impact on biodiversity and sustainability

components.description_pt: Discutir estratégias de conservação baseadas em análise do impacto humano na biodiversidade
components.description_en: Discuss conservation strategies based on analysis of human impact on biodiversity
components.cc_component_description: Apply scientific principles to propose strategies that minimize a specific human impact on the environment

cc_matches.description: The sustainability of human societies and the biodiversity that supports them requires responsible management of natural resources.

Human activities have significantly altered the biosphere, sometimes damaging or destroying natural habitats and causing the extinction of other species. But changes to Earth’s environments can have different impacts (negative and positive) for different living things.
Apply scientific principles to design a method for monitoring and minimizing a human impact on the environment.
